# Two splits: one on a liability account, the other on an expense account.
# `Liabilities:Credit Card USD` −150.00 against `Expenses:Supplies:USD`
# +150.00.
#
# More than the bill turns out to owe, so linking it has to divide the split:
# 100.00 settles the bill and 50.00 stays with the vendor as a credit.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-26 * "Paid the supplier too much on the card"
	guid: "778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 150.00 USD
		guid: "8899aabbccddeeff001122334455667a"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Credit Card USD -150.00 USD
		guid: "99aabbccddeeff001122334455667a88"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
